name: Meeko
source:
Occupation: None
Stay as: Stray

This young girl was discovered abandoned by the Saranaga Rapids, which led the most of the Yasumizu inhabitants to be wary of her.

She has been given the nickname "Meiko" simply because no one knows her real name. She often cries "Baa!".

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]

[spoiler]Her real identity is the Black Goat from the Pasture Project. She later grows up to become Miyo Tougo in [url=/v15053]Death Match Love Comedy[/url].[/spoiler]
